Title: Vihaan and the Family

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Pihu - 11 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Zoya - 11 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Vimla - 67 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Vihaan stands in the park. Anjali stands near him.]

Vihaan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vihaan kicks the football hard.]

Vihaan (softly): "One more time!"

[Vihaan goes down the slide.]

Anjali: "What happened?"

[Vihaan plays with his dog.]

Anjali (happily): "What happened?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Vimla stand near him.]

Anjali: "Vihaan, look over here."

[Vihaan hugs Mother tightly.]

Anjali: "Exactly right."

[Vihaan shakes his head.]

Vihaan: "Oh wow!"

[Vihaan gives Mother a flower.]

Vimla (excited): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Vihaan pats his horse.]

Vihaan: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Anjali and Vimla stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Let's begin."

[Vihaan lies down on the sofa.]

Vimla: "Yes, all right."

[Vihaan sits down on a chair.]

Vihaan: "Really?"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Night

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Pihu stand near him.]

Anjali: "Pihu, look over here."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Pihu: "Vihaan, look at this."

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Vihaan: "That was such a fun day!"
